haiku.text:
A missing flow never counts as passed. The diff is UI-relevant but no flow is registered for this repo, so feature-validate records an explicit skip reason in the verify_ui block of validate-{N}.json, keeping the coverage gap visible.

```json
{"phase_result": "skipped", "skip_reason": "UI-relevant diff but no verify-ui flow registered for this repo"}
```
